test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The internal and external diameters of a bowl in the shape of a hemisphere are 26.6 cm and 28 cm, respectively. What is the cost (in ₹, to the nearest rupee) of painting it, all over, at the rate of ₹3.75/cm²? 

(Take π = frac{22}7).
solution:
**Given:**

Internal diameter = 26.6 cm

External diameter = 28 cm

Rate of painting = ₹3.75/cm²

Use π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Internal radius (rᵢₙ) = Internal diameter ÷ 2

External radius (rₒᵤₜ) = External diameter ÷ 2

Area of a hemisphere = 2πr²

Area of a ring = π(rₒᵤₜ² - rᵢₙ²)

Total Cost = Total Area × Rate
